sloka: अयम् रामो महाप्राज्ञ संप्राप्तो दृढ विक्रमः ।लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा रामोऽयम् सत्य विक्रमः ॥४-५-२॥
transliteration: ayam rāmo mahāprājña saṁprāpto dṛḍha vikramaḥ ।lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā rāmo'yam satya vikramaḥ ॥4-5-2॥

translations.english: 'This Rama of greatwisdom and valour, endowed with the power of truth has arrived here along with his brother Lakshmana.
